name: rust-engineering
description: Automatic Rust engineering orchestration with 44 focused skills and a 265-rule context-aware Rust coding rulebook.

interface.shortDescription: Route Rust work through focused skills.
interface.longDescription: Starts with a fast read-only Rust context hook, then routes implementation through one primary and at most two supporting engineering profiles. A progressive-disclosure overlay selects up to eight relevant rules from 265 addressable Rust coding rules. Includes findings-first review, evidence-only verification, language and Cargo policy, architecture, runtime, interop, and Nix workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $rust-workflow to route this Rust change, apply relevant $rust-coding-rules, implement it, and verify the result.
